fact: A state data hosting centre was set up in 2022 with World Bank financing but is not yet operational, for lack of an agreement between its manager Comores Cable and the State and of a digital administration platform; the project would build a main national data centre and run the state centre as secondary, with a private operator under a PPP.
title: Comorian Economic Digitalisation Support Project (PADEC), Project Appraisal Report
